_comment: Differential corpus for outsideScoringWindow(nowMs, startsAt, endsAt): the SCORING window, where a start is REQUIRED (issue #464: every event needs an official launch). Duplicated verbatim in apps/web/src/lib/schedule-window.ts, scorer/src/store.js and sync/src/redis.js; each reader's suite runs every row here against its own copy. The generic outsideWindow corpus (window-corpus.json) still covers the registration window, where an absent bound means open. S/E below are fixed instants: S = 2023-11-14T22:13:20.000Z, E = S + 1h.

cases.description: no start, no end: not launched
no start, future end: still not launched
started, unparseable end: end ignored, inside
